verdict: NO_ADOPT — all three preregistered candidates failed the frozen gates. V13 remains the sole card model. No retuning, no threshold movement, per the prereg's own on_fail clause.

results_n1054_81_dates.C1 v13_platt: Brier 0.24950 (WORSE, dBrier +0.0024, p_holm 0.95) — walk-forward recalibration overcorrected out-of-sample (test-window slope 2.02). 0/4 checks.
results_n1054_81_dates.C2 logit7: Brier 0.24682 (tie: dBrier -0.00025, CI [-0.0039,+0.0036], p_holm 1.0) — well calibrated (slope 1.069) but not better. 3/4 checks; fails significance. Confirms the 8/10 result under this harness.
results_n1054_81_dates.C3 logit9 (+rest,+form10): Brier 0.24754; the block ablation vs C2 is dBrier +0.0007, p_raw 0.46 — rest days and 10-game form carry NO incremental signal here. 2/5 checks.

the_finding_that_matters.claim: V13's binding constraint is DISCRIMINATION, not calibration.
the_finding_that_matters.evidence: On the eligible window V13's AUC is 0.566 and its calibration slope is 0.842 — its small deviations from .500 are already slightly TOO LARGE for the signal they carry. A recalibration layer cannot fix a weak-AUC model (C1 proved it by losing), and refitting the same 7 features cannot either (C2 tied). The 'compression' the owner named is real as a description of the output distribution, but the cure is more signal, not a stretch of the existing signal.
the_finding_that_matters.where_more_signal_lives: exactly the V14 data-blocked queue: confirmed lineups, bullpen availability/fatigue, starter-recency detail, official pregame confirmations. The 8/10 block ablations already showed starter-block dominance; today shows the cheap residual features (rest, form) add nothing. Accuracy improvement is now a DATA ACQUISITION problem, not a fitting problem.
practical_next_steps_in_priority_order: 1. Keep the personnel-layer pattern from the v5 track: prospective, hash-bound pregame lineup/bullpen capture for MLB (the WNBA/NFL personnel contract is directly reusable). This feeds V14's blocked features the only legitimate way — prospectively.
2. Continue the active ML-P4-FORWARD experiment untouched — prospective evidence remains the scarcest asset.
3. Do not spend further compute refitting the frozen feature set; today's Holm family is the third null result on that surface.

governance.note: The rigor stack did its job: three plausible 'enhancements' were prevented from being adopted on noise. A NO_ADOPT under frozen gates is a successful experiment, not a failed one.
